target: External (lateral) bracts on the wall of the fig (syconium) are absent. The basal bracts are present (bract PO_0009055 triangular, PATO_0001875 via 'deltoïdes'). PO has no class for the external bracts of a fig, so make no taxon-level absence of bract PO_0009055.

In Ficus, the bracts of the receptacle are named by position (basal, lateral, ostiolar). Never turn the absence of one set into bract PO_0009055 absent when another set is described.
reason: Ficus figs are described as having basal bracts, with or without lateral bracts scattered on the receptacle. The same description gives deltoid basal bracts, so bracts as such are present.

target: Style PO_0009074 is absent in the ray florets only (sterile, neuter ray florets of Melanthera). The disc florets have a style. Context: ray floret vs disc floret. The glabrous corolla tube does not conflict with this.

reason: Melanthera has neuter ray florets without a style and fertile disc florets. 'Style absent' comes from the ray-floret part of the description.

target: On the fig (syconium) the lateral bracts are absent and the apical (ostiolar) bracts are present: 5, ± erect, verticillate. Context: position on the receptacle (lateral vs apical). No absence of bract PO_0009055 for the taxon.
fix: 'without lateral bracts' negates only the lateral bracts of the receptacle. In Ficus, apical/ostiolar bracts and basal bracts are separate sets. Keep the position as context and never map it to bract PO_0009055 absent.
reason: Ficus descriptions routinely say 'without lateral bracts' and then describe the apical bracts around the ostiole. Both statements hold.

target: The dots (minute dark dots or punctations on the lower leaf surface) are absent. The leaf is not punctate (negation of PATO_0001512 punctate on leaf lamina PO_0020039). Read it as punctate / not punctate on the surface of the organ being described, or give no annotation. Never make it an absence of that organ.

target: The lower surface of the leaf lamina PO_0020039 has no dots, i.e. it is not punctate (PATO_0001512 negated). Make no absence annotation. The lamina is present and olivaceous to brown.

target: The palea PO_0009038 is absent in the sterile (incomplete) florets only, which are reduced to lemmas. The female-fertile floret has a coriaceous palea. Context: sterile vs fertile floret.

reason: Chusquea has two sterile florets below the fertile one, reduced to empty lemmas. The fertile floret's palea is described as coriaceous.

target: Trichome PO_0000282 is absent on the leaf (leaf anatomy: 'Hairs: absent'). Leaf PO_0025034 is present, and the stomata are described.
fix: In a structured anatomy block ('Hairs: absent', 'Papillae: absent', 'Stomata: ...'), the heading word is the bearer of the value and the organ of the block is its location. 'Hairs: absent' is trichome PO_0000282 absent on that organ, never the organ absent.
reason: The Smithsonian Velloziaceae leaf-anatomy texts list hairs, stomata and other cells as separate fields. The leaf is obviously present.

target: The woody caudex is absent. PO has no caudex class ('caudex' is only a lexicon synonym of stem PO_0009047), so make no annotation. Keep stem PO_0009047 solid (PATO_0001544).

target: Axillary leaf fascicles (secondary leaves in the axils) are absent. PO has no class for these, so make no annotation. The main leaves PO_0025034 are present.

target: Leaf lamina PO_0020039 is absent from the basal sheaths only (the bladeless basal cataphylls, leaf sheath PO_0020104). The foliage leaves have flat blades. No taxon-level absence of the lamina.

target: Leaf sheath auricle PO_0020106 absent (PATO_0000462), and the oral setae (trichome PO_0000282 at the sheath mouth) absent, on the culm sheath. 'Leathery' describes the sheath (leaf sheath PO_0020104, context culm sheath), not a stipule. Both records were wrongly put on stipule.

target: No annotation: 'Flowers not known' means missing data. The flowers are not absent. The 1-fruited cymes (cyme inflorescence PO_0030126, in fruit) stay.

target: No annotation for 'Flowers not seen' (missing data). 'Infructescences terminal' maps to infructescence PO_0006342 terminal, not inflorescence.

target: Leaf sheath auricle PO_0020106 absent on the culm sheath (context: culm sheath). 'Culm sheath persistent' is the sheath (leaf sheath PO_0020104, context culm sheath) non-deciduous, not stipule present. Both records were wrongly put on stipule.
